properties.statement: searchsorted returns the least 1-based k with xs[k] ≥ x, or N+1; so its result is in [1, N+1] (and fits Int32 for N < 2^31 − 1).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (xs : List ℝ) (x : ℝ), have k := Esm.Closed.searchsorted (Esm.Closed.Num.fin x) (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin xs); (1 : ℕ) ≤ k ∧ k ≤ xs.length + (1 : ℕ) ∧ (∀ (j : ℕ), j + (1 : ℕ) < k → xs.getD j (0 : ℝ) < x) ∧ (k ≤ xs.length → x ≤ xs.getD (k - (1 : ℕ)) (0 : ℝ))

properties.statement: A NaN query returns N+1, whatever xs holds.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (xs : List Esm.Closed.Num), Esm.Closed.searchsorted Esm.Closed.Num.nan xs = xs.length + (1 : ℕ)

properties.statement: searchsorted is monotone in x, with NaN above every real.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (xs : List ℝ) (x y : ℝ), x ≤ y → Esm.Closed.searchsorted (Esm.Closed.Num.fin x) (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin xs) ≤ Esm.Closed.searchsorted (Esm.Closed.Num.fin y) (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin xs) ∧ Esm.Closed.searchsorted (Esm.Closed.Num.fin y) (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin xs) ≤ Esm.Closed.searchsorted Esm.Closed.Num.nan (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin xs)

properties.statement: x ≤ xs[1] gives 1; on a non-decreasing xs, x > xs[N] gives N+1.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (xs : List ℝ) (x : ℝ), xs ≠ [] → (x ≤ xs.getD (0 : ℕ) (0 : ℝ) → Esm.Closed.searchsorted (Esm.Closed.Num.fin x) (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin xs) = (1 : ℕ)) ∧ (List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 ≤ x2) xs → xs.getD (xs.length - (1 : ℕ)) (0 : ℝ) < x → Esm.Closed.searchsorted (Esm.Closed.Num.fin x) (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin xs) = xs.length + (1 : ℕ))

properties.statement: A const xs is accepted iff it is NaN-free and non-decreasing (Q-7).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (xs : List Esm.Closed.Num), (∃ (v : List Esm.Closed.Num), Esm.Closed.validateSearchsorted (Esm.Closed.Arg.const1 xs) = Except.ok v) ↔ ∃ (r : List ℝ), xs = List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin r ∧ List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 ≤ x2) r

properties.statement: Q-7: a NaN in xs is searchsorted_nan, checked before monotonicity.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (xs : List Esm.Closed.Num), (∃ x ∈ xs, x.isNaN = Bool.true) → Esm.Closed.validateSearchsorted (Esm.Closed.Arg.const1 xs) = Except.error "searchsorted_nan"

properties.statement: A NaN-free xs that is not non-decreasing is searchsorted_non_monotonic.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (r : List ℝ), ¬List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 ≤ x2) r → Esm.Closed.validateSearchsorted (Esm.Closed.Arg.const1 (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin r)) = Except.error "searchsorted_non_monotonic"

properties.statement: Inside a cell a_i ≤ x < a_{i+1} (x > a_1), interp.linear is the pinned blend t_i + w·(t_{i+1} − t_i) with w = (x − a_i)/(a_{i+1} − a_i).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (t : List Esm.Closed.Num) (a : List ℝ), List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) a → ∀ (i : ℕ) (x : ℝ), i + (1 : ℕ) < a.length → a.getD i (0 : ℝ) ≤ x → x < a.getD (i + (1 : ℕ)) (0 : ℝ) → a.getD (0 : ℕ) (0 : ℝ) < x → Esm.Closed.linear t (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin a) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin x) = Esm.Closed.blend (t.getD i Esm.Closed.Num.nan) (t.getD (i + (1 : ℕ)) Esm.Closed.Num.nan) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin ((x - a.getD i (0 : ℝ)) / (a.getD (i + (1 : ℕ)) (0 : ℝ) - a.getD i (0 : ℝ))))

properties.statement: x ≤ a_1 returns t_1.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (t : List Esm.Closed.Num) (a : List ℝ), (2 : ℕ) ≤ a.length → ∀ x ≤ a.getD (0 : ℕ) (0 : ℝ), Esm.Closed.linear t (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin a) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin x) = t.getD (0 : ℕ) Esm.Closed.Num.nan

properties.statement: x ≥ a_N returns t_N.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (t : List Esm.Closed.Num) (a : List ℝ), List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) a → (2 : ℕ) ≤ a.length → ∀ (x : ℝ), a.getD (a.length - (1 : ℕ)) (0 : ℝ) ≤ x → Esm.Closed.linear t (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin a) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin x) = t.getD (a.length - (1 : ℕ)) Esm.Closed.Num.nan

properties.statement: A NaN query returns NaN.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (t ax : List Esm.Closed.Num), Esm.Closed.linear t ax Esm.Closed.Num.nan = Esm.Closed.Num.nan

properties.statement: Over ℝ, a query on knot k returns t_k exactly, provided (for an interior knot) t_{k+1} is not NaN.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (t : List Esm.Closed.Num) (a : List ℝ), List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) a → (2 : ℕ) ≤ a.length → ∀ k < a.length, ((0 : ℕ) < k → k + (1 : ℕ) < a.length → (t.getD (k + (1 : ℕ)) Esm.Closed.Num.nan).isNaN = Bool.false) → Esm.Closed.linear t (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin a) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin (a.getD k (0 : ℝ))) = t.getD k Esm.Closed.Num.nan

properties.statement: An interior knot whose right neighbour is NaN returns NaN (the knot belongs to the cell with the NaN corner); the spec's unconditional 'w = 0 ⇒ result = t_i' needs that proviso.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (t : List Esm.Closed.Num) (a : List ℝ), List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) a → ∀ (k : ℕ), (0 : ℕ) < k → k + (1 : ℕ) < a.length → (t.getD (k + (1 : ℕ)) Esm.Closed.Num.nan).isNaN = Bool.true → Esm.Closed.linear t (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin a) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin (a.getD k (0 : ℝ))) = Esm.Closed.Num.nan

properties.statement: An in-range result lies between the two bracketing table values.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (t : List Esm.Closed.Num) (a : List ℝ), List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) a → (2 : ℕ) ≤ a.length → ∀ (i : ℕ) (x p q : ℝ), i + (1 : ℕ) < a.length → a.getD i (0 : ℝ) ≤ x → x < a.getD (i + (1 : ℕ)) (0 : ℝ) → t.getD i Esm.Closed.Num.nan = Esm.Closed.Num.fin p → t.getD (i + (1 : ℕ)) Esm.Closed.Num.nan = Esm.Closed.Num.fin q → ∃ (r : ℝ), Esm.Closed.linear t (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin a) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin x) = Esm.Closed.Num.fin r ∧ Min.min p q ≤ r ∧ r ≤ Max.max p q

properties.statement: A query in a cell with a NaN corner returns NaN.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (t : List Esm.Closed.Num) (a : List ℝ), List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) a → ∀ (i : ℕ) (x : ℝ), i + (1 : ℕ) < a.length → a.getD i (0 : ℝ) ≤ x → x < a.getD (i + (1 : ℕ)) (0 : ℝ) → a.getD (0 : ℕ) (0 : ℝ) < x → (t.getD i Esm.Closed.Num.nan).isNaN = Bool.true ∨ (t.getD (i + (1 : ℕ)) Esm.Closed.Num.nan).isNaN = Bool.true → Esm.Closed.linear t (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin a) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin x) = Esm.Closed.Num.nan

properties.statement: Outside the table, bilinear equals bilinear at the query clamped per axis (extrapolate-flat).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (T : List (List Esm.Closed.Num)) (ax ay : List ℝ), List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) ax → List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) ay → (2 : ℕ) ≤ ax.length → (2 : ℕ) ≤ ay.length → ∀ (x y : ℝ), Esm.Closed.bilinear T (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin ax) (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin ay) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin x) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin y) = Esm.Closed.bilinear T (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin ax) (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin ay) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin (Max.max (ax.getD (0 : ℕ) (0 : ℝ)) (Min.min x (ax.getD (ax.length - (1 : ℕ)) (0 : ℝ))))) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin (Max.max (ay.getD (0 : ℕ) (0 : ℝ)) (Min.min y (ay.getD (ay.length - (1 : ℕ)) (0 : ℝ)))))

properties.statement: NaN x or NaN y gives NaN.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (T : List (List Esm.Closed.Num)) (ax ay : List Esm.Closed.Num) (v : Esm.Closed.Num), Esm.Closed.bilinear T ax ay Esm.Closed.Num.nan v = Esm.Closed.Num.nan ∧ Esm.Closed.bilinear T ax ay v Esm.Closed.Num.nan = Esm.Closed.Num.nan

properties.statement: A query in cell (i, j) is the pinned two-x-blends-then-y-blend in that cell.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (T : List (List Esm.Closed.Num)) (ax ay : List ℝ), List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) ax → List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) ay → ∀ (i j : ℕ) (x y : ℝ), Esm.Closed.InCell ax i x → Esm.Closed.InCell ay j y → Esm.Closed.bilinear T (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin ax) (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin ay) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin x) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin y) = Esm.Closed.bilinearCell T (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin ax) (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin ay) i j (Esm.Closed.Num.fin x) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin y)

properties.statement: Over ℝ on a finite table, a query on knot (k, l) returns table[k][l].
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (U : List (List ℝ)) (ax ay : List ℝ), List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) ax → List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) ay → (2 : ℕ) ≤ ax.length → (2 : ℕ) ≤ ay.length → Esm.Closed.TableShape U ax.length ay.length → ∀ (k l : ℕ), k < ax.length → l < ay.length → Esm.Closed.bilinear (Esm.Closed.finTable U) (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin ax) (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin ay) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin (ax.getD k (0 : ℝ))) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin (ay.getD l (0 : ℝ))) = Esm.Closed.Num.fin (Esm.Closed.rentry U k l)

properties.statement: Over ℝ on a finite table, the result lies between the min and max of its cell's four corners.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (U : List (List ℝ)) (ax ay : List ℝ), List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) ax → List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) ay → Esm.Closed.TableShape U ax.length ay.length → ∀ (i j : ℕ) (x y : ℝ), Esm.Closed.InCell ax i x → Esm.Closed.InCell ay j y → ∃ (r : ℝ), Esm.Closed.bilinear (Esm.Closed.finTable U) (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin ax) (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin ay) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin x) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin y) = Esm.Closed.Num.fin r ∧ Min.min (Min.min (Esm.Closed.rentry U i j) (Esm.Closed.rentry U (i + (1 : ℕ)) j)) (Min.min (Esm.Closed.rentry U i (j + (1 : ℕ))) (Esm.Closed.rentry U (i + (1 : ℕ)) (j + (1 : ℕ)))) ≤ r ∧ r ≤ Max.max (Max.max (Esm.Closed.rentry U i j) (Esm.Closed.rentry U (i + (1 : ℕ)) j)) (Max.max (Esm.Closed.rentry U i (j + (1 : ℕ))) (Esm.Closed.rentry U (i + (1 : ℕ)) (j + (1 : ℕ))))

properties.statement: Over ℝ, at an interior x-knot the alternative cell i = k−1 (w = 1) gives the same value as the pinned i = k (w = 0).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (U : List (List ℝ)) (ax ay : List ℝ), List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) ax → ∀ (k j : ℕ), (0 : ℕ) < k → k + (1 : ℕ) < ax.length → ∀ (y : ℝ), Esm.Closed.realCell U ax ay (k - (1 : ℕ)) j (ax.getD k (0 : ℝ)) y = Esm.Closed.realCell U ax ay k j (ax.getD k (0 : ℝ)) y

properties.statement: A query in a cell with a NaN corner gives NaN.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (T : List (List Esm.Closed.Num)) (ax ay : List ℝ), List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) ax → List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) ay → ∀ (i j : ℕ) (x y : ℝ), Esm.Closed.InCell ax i x → Esm.Closed.InCell ay j y → (Esm.Closed.entry T i j).isNaN = Bool.true ∨ (Esm.Closed.entry T (i + (1 : ℕ)) j).isNaN = Bool.true ∨ (Esm.Closed.entry T i (j + (1 : ℕ))).isNaN = Bool.true ∨ (Esm.Closed.entry T (i + (1 : ℕ)) (j + (1 : ℕ))).isNaN = Bool.true → Esm.Closed.bilinear T (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin ax) (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin ay) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin x) (Esm.Closed.Num.fin y) = Esm.Closed.Num.nan

properties.statement: interp.linear's arguments are accepted iff both are rank-1 const arrays, len(axis) ≥ 2, the lengths agree, and the axis is NaN-free and strictly increasing (table entries may be NaN, Q-5).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (t ax : Esm.Closed.Arg Esm.Closed.Num), (∃ (v : List Esm.Closed.Num × List Esm.Closed.Num), Esm.Closed.validateLinear t ax = Except.ok v) ↔ ∃ (t' : List Esm.Closed.Num) (ax' : List Esm.Closed.Num), t = Esm.Closed.Arg.const1 t' ∧ ax = Esm.Closed.Arg.const1 ax' ∧ (2 : ℕ) ≤ ax'.length ∧ t'.length = ax'.length ∧ ∃ (r : List ℝ), ax' = List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin r ∧ List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) r

properties.statement: A non-const table is interp_table_not_const; a const table with a non-const axis is interp_axis_not_const.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (t ax : Esm.Closed.Arg Esm.Closed.Num), Esm.Closed.validateLinear Esm.Closed.Arg.other ax = Except.error "interp_table_not_const" ∧ (t ≠ Esm.Closed.Arg.other → Esm.Closed.validateLinear t Esm.Closed.Arg.other = Except.error "interp_axis_not_const")

properties.statement: Every rejection of rank-1 const arguments names a condition that is violated.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (t ax : List Esm.Closed.Num) (c : Esm.Closed.Code), Esm.Closed.validateLinear (Esm.Closed.Arg.const1 t) (Esm.Closed.Arg.const1 ax) = Except.error c → c = "interp_axis_too_short" ∧ ax.length < (2 : ℕ) ∨ c = "interp_axis_length_mismatch" ∧ t.length ≠ ax.length ∨ (c = "interp_nan_in_axis" ∧ ∃ x ∈ ax, x.isNaN = Bool.true) ∨ c = "interp_non_monotonic_axis" ∧ ∃ (r : List ℝ), ax = List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin r ∧ ¬List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) r

properties.statement: Q-4: when the shape checks pass, a NaN axis entry is interp_nan_in_axis, never interp_non_monotonic_axis.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (t ax : List Esm.Closed.Num), (2 : ℕ) ≤ ax.length → t.length = ax.length → (∃ x ∈ ax, x.isNaN = Bool.true) → Esm.Closed.validateLinear (Esm.Closed.Arg.const1 t) (Esm.Closed.Arg.const1 ax) = Except.error "interp_nan_in_axis"

properties.statement: interp.bilinear's const arguments are accepted iff Nx, Ny ≥ 2, the table is Nx rows of length Ny, and both axes are NaN-free and strictly increasing.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (T : List (List Esm.Closed.Num)) (ax ay : List Esm.Closed.Num), (∃ (v : List (List Esm.Closed.Num) × List Esm.Closed.Num × List Esm.Closed.Num), Esm.Closed.validateBilinear (Esm.Closed.Arg.const2 T) (Esm.Closed.Arg.const1 ax) (Esm.Closed.Arg.const1 ay) = Except.ok v) ↔ (2 : ℕ) ≤ ax.length ∧ (2 : ℕ) ≤ ay.length ∧ T.length = ax.length ∧ (∀ row ∈ T, row.length = ay.length) ∧ (∃ (r : List ℝ), ax = List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin r ∧ List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) r) ∧ ∃ (r : List ℝ), ay = List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin r ∧ List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) r

properties.statement: A non-const table is interp_table_not_const, and only rank-2/rank-1/rank-1 const arguments are accepted.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (T ax ay : Esm.Closed.Arg Esm.Closed.Num), Esm.Closed.validateBilinear Esm.Closed.Arg.other ax ay = Except.error "interp_table_not_const" ∧ ((∃ (v : List (List Esm.Closed.Num) × List Esm.Closed.Num × List Esm.Closed.Num), Esm.Closed.validateBilinear T ax ay = Except.ok v) → ∃ (T' : List (List Esm.Closed.Num)) (ax' : List Esm.Closed.Num) (ay' : List Esm.Closed.Num), T = Esm.Closed.Arg.const2 T' ∧ ax = Esm.Closed.Arg.const1 ax' ∧ ay = Esm.Closed.Arg.const1 ay')

properties.statement: Every rejection of const bilinear arguments names a violated condition.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (T : List (List Esm.Closed.Num)) (ax ay : List Esm.Closed.Num) (c : Esm.Closed.Code), Esm.Closed.validateBilinear (Esm.Closed.Arg.const2 T) (Esm.Closed.Arg.const1 ax) (Esm.Closed.Arg.const1 ay) = Except.error c → c = "interp_axis_too_short" ∧ (ax.length < (2 : ℕ) ∨ ay.length < (2 : ℕ)) ∨ c = "interp_axis_length_mismatch" ∧ (T.length ≠ ax.length ∨ ∃ row ∈ T, row.length ≠ ay.length) ∨ c = "interp_nan_in_axis" ∧ ((∃ x ∈ ax, x.isNaN = Bool.true) ∨ ∃ y ∈ ay, y.isNaN = Bool.true) ∨ c = "interp_non_monotonic_axis" ∧ ((∃ (r : List ℝ), ax = List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin r ∧ ¬List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) r) ∨ ∃ (r : List ℝ), ay = List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin r ∧ ¬List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 < x2) r)

properties.statement: Q-4: a NaN in either axis is interp_nan_in_axis, even when the other axis is non-monotonic.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (T : List (List Esm.Closed.Num)) (ax ay : List Esm.Closed.Num), (2 : ℕ) ≤ ax.length → (2 : ℕ) ≤ ay.length → T.length = ax.length → (∀ row ∈ T, row.length = ay.length) → ((∃ x ∈ ax, x.isNaN = Bool.true) ∨ ∃ y ∈ ay, y.isNaN = Bool.true) → Esm.Closed.validateBilinear (Esm.Closed.Arg.const2 T) (Esm.Closed.Arg.const1 ax) (Esm.Closed.Arg.const1 ay) = Except.error "interp_nan_in_axis"

properties.statement: Q-6: for doubles t, u and any w ∈ [0, 1], the pinned blend t ⊕ (w ⊗ (u ⊖ t)) and the FMA blend fma(w, u ⊖ t, t) differ by at most 2·ulp(max(|t|, |u|)).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (t u w : ℝ), Esm.F64.Repr t → Esm.F64.Repr u → (0 : ℝ) ≤ w → w ≤ (1 : ℝ) → |Esm.Closed.Rounding.blend64 t u w - Esm.Closed.Rounding.blendFMA t u w| ≤ (2 : ℝ) * Esm.F64.ulp (Max.max |t| |u|)

properties.statement: Q-6 for interp.linear (and each blend of interp.bilinear): with the pinned binary64 weight of a query in its cell, FMA and non-FMA results differ by at most 2·ulp(max(|t_i|, |t_{i+1}|)).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (t u x lo hi : ℝ), Esm.F64.Repr t → Esm.F64.Repr u → lo ≤ x → x ≤ hi → |Esm.Closed.Rounding.blend64 t u (Esm.Closed.Rounding.weight64 x lo hi) - Esm.Closed.Rounding.blendFMA t u (Esm.Closed.Rounding.weight64 x lo hi)| ≤ (2 : ℝ) * Esm.F64.ulp (Max.max |t| |u|)

properties.statement: The constant 2 is attained (interp.linear([−(2^53−1)·2^−55, (2^53−3)·2^−54], [0, 1], 0.75)), so 2 is the least integer constant.
properties.lean_statement: ∃ (t : ℝ) (u : ℝ) (x : ℝ) (lo : ℝ) (hi : ℝ), Esm.F64.Repr t ∧ Esm.F64.Repr u ∧ Esm.F64.Repr x ∧ Esm.F64.Repr lo ∧ Esm.F64.Repr hi ∧ lo ≤ x ∧ x ≤ hi ∧ |Esm.Closed.Rounding.blend64 t u (Esm.Closed.Rounding.weight64 x lo hi) - Esm.Closed.Rounding.blendFMA t u (Esm.Closed.Rounding.weight64 x lo hi)| = (2 : ℝ) * Esm.F64.ulp (Max.max |t| |u|)

properties.statement: The spec's mixed-FMA relaxation {abs: 0, rel: 4e-16} bounds the FMA difference. REFUTED by cancellation: interp.linear([1, −2], [0, 3], 1) is 0 pinned and 2^−54 with FMA.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ t u x lo hi : ℝ, Esm.F64.Repr t → Esm.F64.Repr u → Esm.F64.Repr x → Esm.F64.Repr lo → Esm.F64.Repr hi → lo ≤ x → x ≤ hi → |Esm.Closed.Rounding.blendFMA t u (Esm.Closed.Rounding.weight64 x lo hi) - Esm.Closed.Rounding.blend64 t u (Esm.Closed.Rounding.weight64 x lo hi)| ≤ 4e-16 * |Esm.Closed.Rounding.blend64 t u (Esm.Closed.Rounding.weight64 x lo hi)|

properties.statement: §9.2 'w = 0 ⇒ result = t_i exactly' holds in binary64 (signed zero not modelled).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (t u : ℝ), Esm.F64.Repr t → Esm.Closed.Rounding.blend64 t u (0 : ℝ) = t

properties.statement: A query on its cell's left knot has pinned binary64 weight exactly 0.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (lo hi : ℝ), Esm.Closed.Rounding.weight64 lo lo hi = (0 : ℝ)

properties.statement: At w = 1 the pinned blend returns t_{i+1} exactly when t_i/2 ≤ t_{i+1} ≤ 2·t_i (exact subtraction).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (t u : ℝ), Esm.F64.Repr t → Esm.F64.Repr u → t / (2 : ℝ) ≤ u → u ≤ (2 : ℝ) * t → Esm.Closed.Rounding.blend64 t u (1 : ℝ) = u

properties.statement: At w = 1 the pinned blend is within 3/2·ulp(max(|t_i|, |t_{i+1}|)) of t_{i+1}.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (t u : ℝ), Esm.F64.Repr t → Esm.F64.Repr u → |Esm.Closed.Rounding.blend64 t u (1 : ℝ) - u| ≤ (3 / 2 : ℝ) * Esm.F64.ulp (Max.max |t| |u|)

properties.statement: For double corners and weights in [0, 1], the pinned binary64 bilinear result is within 11/2·ulp(max |corner|) of the exact bilinear value, and the all-FMA result within 3·ulp.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (t00 t10 t01 t11 wx wy : ℝ), Esm.F64.Repr t00 → Esm.F64.Repr t10 → Esm.F64.Repr t01 → Esm.F64.Repr t11 → (0 : ℝ) ≤ wx → wx ≤ (1 : ℝ) → (0 : ℝ) ≤ wy → wy ≤ (1 : ℝ) → have M := Max.max (Max.max |t00| |t10|) (Max.max |t01| |t11|); |Esm.Closed.Rounding.bilinear64 t00 t10 t01 t11 wx wy - Esm.Closed.Rounding.bilinearR t00 t10 t01 t11 wx wy| ≤ (11 / 2 : ℝ) * Esm.F64.ulp M ∧ |Esm.Closed.Rounding.bilinearFMA t00 t10 t01 t11 wx wy - Esm.Closed.Rounding.bilinearR t00 t10 t01 t11 wx wy| ≤ (3 : ℝ) * Esm.F64.ulp M

properties.statement: Q-6 for interp.bilinear: the all-FMA and the pinned evaluations differ by at most 17/2·ulp(max |corner|).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (t00 t10 t01 t11 wx wy : ℝ), Esm.F64.Repr t00 → Esm.F64.Repr t10 → Esm.F64.Repr t01 → Esm.F64.Repr t11 → (0 : ℝ) ≤ wx → wx ≤ (1 : ℝ) → (0 : ℝ) ≤ wy → wy ≤ (1 : ℝ) → |Esm.Closed.Rounding.bilinear64 t00 t10 t01 t11 wx wy - Esm.Closed.Rounding.bilinearFMA t00 t10 t01 t11 wx wy| ≤ (17 / 2 : ℝ) * Esm.F64.ulp (Max.max (Max.max |t00| |t10|) (Max.max |t01| |t11|))

properties.statement: Q-2/Q-8: an enums block loads iff values are unique within each enum (no constraint on the values themselves, so 0 and negatives load); a duplicate is enum_duplicate_value.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (es : Esm.Closed.Enums.EnumsBlock), (Esm.Closed.Enums.validateEnums es = Except.ok () ↔ ∀ e ∈ es, (List.map Prod.snd e.2).Nodup) ∧ ((∃ e ∈ es, ¬(List.map Prod.snd e.2).Nodup) → Esm.Closed.Enums.validateEnums es = Except.error "enum_duplicate_value")

properties.statement: Values may coincide across enums.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (n₁ n₂ : String) (m₁ m₂ : Esm.Closed.Enums.Enum), (List.map Prod.snd m₁).Nodup → (List.map Prod.snd m₂).Nodup → Esm.Closed.Enums.validateEnums [(n₁, m₁), (n₂, m₂)] = Except.ok ()

properties.statement: An enum op resolves to exactly its declared integer (zero and negatives included; no clamping or defaulting).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (es : Esm.Closed.Enums.EnumsBlock) (name sym : String) (m : Esm.Closed.Enums.Enum) (v : ℤ), List.lookup name es = Option.some m → List.lookup sym m = Option.some v → Esm.Closed.Enums.resolve es name sym = Except.ok v

properties.statement: An undeclared enum is unknown_enum, an undeclared symbol unknown_enum_symbol.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (es : Esm.Closed.Enums.EnumsBlock) (name sym : String), (List.lookup name es = Option.none → Esm.Closed.Enums.resolve es name sym = Except.error "unknown_enum") ∧ ∀ (m : Esm.Closed.Enums.Enum), List.lookup name es = Option.some m → List.lookup sym m = Option.none → Esm.Closed.Enums.resolve es name sym = Except.error "unknown_enum_symbol"

properties.statement: §9.2 (old text) 'w = 1 ⇒ result = t_i + (t_{i+1} − t_i) = t_{i+1}' as exact binary64 equality. REFUTED: 1 ⊕ (1 ⊗ (2^−60 ⊖ 1)) = 0. The text now states what holds (P-interp-endpoint-w1-sterbenz, -bound).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ t u : ℝ, Esm.F64.Repr t → Esm.F64.Repr u → Esm.Closed.Rounding.blend64 t u 1 = u

properties.statement: §9.2 bilinear step 2 (old text): the alternative cell i = k−1 (wx = 1) is bit-identical to the pinned i = k (wx = 0, which returns the row at knot k exactly). That needs the wx = 1 blend of rows t[k−1], t[k] to return t[k] exactly in binary64, which fails for rows 1 and 2^−60. The text now says the two agree over ℝ only.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ t u : ℝ, Esm.F64.Repr t → Esm.F64.Repr u → Esm.Closed.Rounding.blend64 t u 1 = u

properties.statement: The LEAST constant c with |bilinear64 − bilinearFMA| ≤ c·ulp(max |corner|). Proven c ≤ 17/2 (P-interp-bilinear-fma-bound); a randomized search over sparse-mantissa doubles attains 4. The gap [4, 17/2] is open.
Q-105: interp.searchsorted's xs is rejected with interp_axis_not_const exactly when it is not a rank-1 const array (the first of its three checks).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (a : Esm.Closed.Arg Esm.Closed.Num), Esm.Closed.validateSearchsorted a = Except.error "interp_axis_not_const" ↔ ∀ (xs : List Esm.Closed.Num), a ≠ Esm.Closed.Arg.const1 xs

properties.statement: Q-7 + Q-105: searchsorted_nan exactly when xs is a rank-1 const array (the first check passes) holding a NaN.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (a : Esm.Closed.Arg Esm.Closed.Num), Esm.Closed.validateSearchsorted a = Except.error "searchsorted_nan" ↔ ∃ (xs : List Esm.Closed.Num), a = Esm.Closed.Arg.const1 xs ∧ ∃ x ∈ xs, x.isNaN = Bool.true

properties.statement: Q-105: searchsorted_non_monotonic exactly when xs is a NaN-free rank-1 const array (the first two checks pass) that is not non-decreasing.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (a : Esm.Closed.Arg Esm.Closed.Num), Esm.Closed.validateSearchsorted a = Except.error "searchsorted_non_monotonic" ↔ ∃ (r : List ℝ), a = Esm.Closed.Arg.const1 (List.map Esm.Closed.Num.fin r) ∧ ¬List.Pairwise (fun (x1 x2 : ℝ) => x1 ≤ x2) r
